rules.H02: Budgeted active components without tasks have zero progress and remain in the monetary denominator. Existing unassigned-task fallback remains unchanged in this correction.
rules.H04: Estimated/earned effort sums leaf work-package estimated hours and independently reported progress, without parent-container double counting. EH=sum(leaf_estimated_hours*leaf_progress/100), independent of component budget weights. Actual hours include all active logs, including parent/general work.
rules.H05: Creating/deleting time logs updates actual hours and may transition todo to in_progress, but never derives or overwrites physical progress from actual/estimated hours. Parent physical rollups remain derived from child physical measurements.
